_readme: Food and bar packages, from the owners' events deck (public/docs/fyc-private-dining-and-events.pdf, Sep 2026). price: a number in dollars, or text such as "Market price". unit: how the price is charged.

food.name: Pass the Dutchie
food.description: Choose five passed appetizers, served for as long as you book the package.

food.name: Graze Me Baby
food.description: An edible grazing table. Ask the team for the menu and a quote.

food.name: Who Needs a Chair?
food.description: Buffet dinner, replenished twice an hour.

bar.name: The Recent Grad
bar.description: Sparkling, one white, one red, three beer or cider selections and non-alcoholic drinks.

bar.name: Limited Partner
bar.description: Standard liquor and calls, plus two specialty cocktails.

bar.name: The Boss Bitch
bar.description: Run of the house, excluding bottled wine.

notes: Bottled wine list and event minimums are available on request.
Extra courses, mains and supplements (long-bone ribeye, Dover sole) are listed in the events deck.
